messages.subject: For Pedro Azagra | Energy transition, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Iberdrola Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pedro Azagra, Chief Executive Officer.

Iberdrola's global renewable-energy and networks strategy depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and major investment programs. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a complex multinational operating environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters and also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and energy-transition experience might support Iberdrola's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Iberdrola.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
